sections.label: Dementia-friendly nursing home designs
sections.summary: New nursing homes have closed-loop outdoor gardens beside dementia wards, and a cluster living concept is being tried at Ren Ci's Ang Mo Kio home.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: For instance, in some of our new purpose-built nursing homes, we have created closed-loop outdoor gardens next to dementia wards, to enable seniors with dementia to move around independently and enjoy the greenery.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: We are also experimenting with a dementia-friendly concept of "cluster living" in Ren Ci's new nursing home in Ang Mo Kio, which is in the midst of construction.

sections.label: Community dementia care pilots
sections.summary: MOH is piloting community care models for persons with dementia, funded under the Community Mental Health Masterplan, so they can be cared for at home.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: MOH is also piloting innovative care models within the community for persons with dementia so that they can continue to be cared for and supported at home and in the community, with funding support provided under the Community Mental Health Masterplan.

sections.label: Innovation challenge and dementia grant
sections.summary: The National Innovation Challenge on Active and Confident Ageing was set up, and MOH launched a grant for preventive programmes and new dementia care models.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Most recently, we set up the National Innovation Challenge on Active and Confident Ageing under the Action Plan for Successful Ageing to catalyse innovative ideas and research to transform the experience of ageing in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Last year, MOH launched a grant for innovative preventive programme to delay the onset of dementia and new models of dementia care in the community.

sections.label: Peacehaven project subsidy discussions
sections.summary: Subsidy policies must consider scalability and resource sustainability beyond single pilots, so discussions continue with Peacehaven Nursing Home and funders on adjusting the project.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Our subsidy policies will need to take into account the scalability and the resource sustainability of the care models at the system levels, beyond any single-pilot project.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Because of this, actually, we are still in discussion with Peacehaven Nursing Home and the funders to look at how the project can be adjusted so that it can proceed.

sections.label: Subvention for care models
sections.summary: The subvention will be given to the different care models, depending on the projects and the programmes.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The subvention will be given to the different care models, depending on the projects, as well as, of course, the programmes.

sections.label: Ramping up home and community care
sections.summary: Home care and community care are being ramped up, and more home care is encouraged and supported for as long as the elderly can be cared for at home.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What we are doing is ramping up home care and community care and we want to encourage and support more home care for as long as the elderly is able to be cared for at home.
